messages:
tanya: Quick thread to align on retention+evidence export beta scope. Goal: hosted-only beta that meets SOC2 evidence needs and supports customer BYOK (import or external KMS). Want concrete launch criteria + owners.

mike: From Eng: we can do per-tenant TTLs + export bundle streaming in ~8-10 wks if we limit to hosted. Key questions: key wrapping flow and whether we need an escrow API.

olga: Security: require design for append-only audit records + signed export manifests. Recommend using detached signatures (RFC 7515-like) so we don't change object layout. Also need key compromise playbook and proof of deletion for rotated keys.

jack: Ops: retention tiers mapping options: hot (90d), warm (1y), cold (7y). Cold should be on archive storage with lifecycle rules. We need retention-cost estimator in Console so customers know expected monthly bill.

sara: Legal: export bundle must include chain-of-custody metadata: actor, reason, hold id, hold start/end, manifest signature, and export audit trail. Also require that exports are immutable and downloadable with checksum.

tanya: Proposal for BYOK options: 1) hosted KMS integration (AWS/GCP) where customer grants our service a key-wrapping permission; 2) key import (wrapped key uploaded to our KMS backend); 3) customer-managed external KMS (we store only wrapped key pointers). For beta support 1+2.

mike: Implementation sketch:\n```\n// export stream pseudocode\nbundle = start_export(tenant_id, from_ts, to_ts)\nfor chunk in stream(bundle):\n  sign_chunk(chunk, manifest_key)\n  upload_chunk(chunk)\nfinalize_manifest(bundle, signatures)\n```\nUse incremental snapshots to avoid heavy memory pressure.

olga: KMS compat matrix: we must support RSA-PSS (signing) and AES-GCM keywrap. List supported: AWS KMS (RSA and ECC), GCP KMS, Vault HSM. Documented algorithms only.

jack: Risk: legal-hold spikes will cause large temporary egress. Ops needs a throttle policy + notification to CS when export > X GB. Also need retention quotas per-tenant to avoid runaway bills.

sara: Add acceptance criteria: export manifest format v1, downloadable tar.gz with manifest.json + signatures, chain-of-custody fields present, access control for who can request/export, audit entry created for export.

tanya: Suggested minimal beta launch criteria (hosted):
- API/UI to set per-tenant retention profile (hot/warm/cold/hold)
- Export endpoint producing signed evidence bundles (streaming)
- BYOK import path + attestation logs (hosted KMS + wrapped key upload)
- Console retention cost preview and per-tenant quota controls
- SOC2/ISO mapping doc showing which controls are covered
Owners: Eng=Mike, Security=Olga, Ops=Jack, Legal=Sara, PM=Tanya.

mike: Timeline check: Eng will estimate tasks and breakdown tomorrow. Quick dev risks: key rotation semantics and supporting both import and grant modes.

olga: We need a threat model doc in spec: escrow compromise, export signing compromise, replay attacks. Also provide steps for forensic export (signed manifests + immutable provenance).

jack: Ops checklist: lifecycle rules, cost estimator hook, quota enforcement, export throttling, monitoring/alerts for large exports.

sara: For pilot customers ask: require signed NDA + defined export SLA. We can pilot with FinPilotA and HealthPilotB.

tanya: Next steps: Eng to post effort estimates by EOD Fri, Legal to draft manifest schema and chain-of-custody fields, Sec to draft threat model, Ops to prototype cost estimator. I'll create spec doc and invite pilot customers.
